## H1: mean implied-minus-realized variance

N=9064; calendar-derived L0=21; mean=0.011348913659506793; median=0.012399001778945488; HAC SE=0.0021025942583363572; z/t=5.397576643477773; two-sided p=6.754702197667221e-08; 95% CI=[0.007227904639, 0.01546992268]. Positive fraction=0.8599955869373345; mean/sample-SD effect=0.2182808602091167. Variance is annualized decimal variance.

Full-sample CC rejects a zero mean. This does not measure the theoretical conditional premium directly or establish a compensation mechanism. The full-sample result weakens in later samples: primary post-2014 CC is insignificant, whereas its deterministic non-overlap result is significant. Retain both; phase/subsample choice is not outcome-selected. Parkinson/GK estimates omit overnight moves and give materially different levels.
